capabilities: insert math blocks into notes via command or cmd + M
write equations in LaTeX or intuitive input that gets parsed
annotate math blocks with Excalidraw drawings saved as SVG
define custom shortcuts that expand text into LaTeX, with before/after parameters
configure colors, block size, metadata, and visible Excalidraw tools
extras: Only works in Live Preview Mode; shortcut settings must be kept in valid JSON and applied via an update button.
problem: Obsidian's math rendering is read-only LaTeX, with no way to hand-draw annotations on top of equations while taking math notes.

relations.evidence: This opens up an Excalidraw instance over the math block

summary: Math note-taking plugin that creates LaTeX math blocks in notes and overlays an Excalidraw canvas for freeform drawing annotations.
